newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 24.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ivory Coast's 1996/97 cocoa campaign begins today Thursday, farm-gate price unchanged.
- South Western port of San Pedro targets two million tonnes of traffic by year 2000. Port officials say port handled 861,455 tonnes in the first nine months of 1996.
- Alliance for Africa's Industrialisation launched in Ivory Coast's commercial capital Abidjan; accent on role of private sector in industrialisation of the continent
- Timber industry professional body SYNGOPID denounces illegal logging in Ivory Coast, saying it threatens their livelihood.
- Bandits gun down policeman in Abidjan's populous Adjame district; police shoot dead two bandits in the city's central Plateau district
